#     python dev/generate_pm_script.py --source "<game>/game" [--source "<mod>"]
#
# Why generated: Victoria 3 has no production_method scope and no way to
# iterate a building's production method groups, and building scopes cannot
# store variables. Anything per-building therefore has to name each building
# type and each production method explicitly.
#
# Snapshot lives in state variables, because a state holds at most one building
# of each type:
#     rpm_lvl_<building_type>      level at the time of the snapshot
#     rpm_pm<N>_<building_type>    index of the active production method in the
#                                  building type's Nth production method group

		limit = { has_building = building_wheat_farm }
		set_variable = { name = rpm_lvl_building_wheat_farm value = b:building_wheat_farm.level }
		if = {
			limit = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_simple_farming } }

			limit = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_herring_meal_farming } }

		}

			limit = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_soil_enriching_farming } }
			set_variable = { name = rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm value = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_fertilization } }
			set_variable = { name = rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm value = 3 }

			set_variable = { name = rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm value = 4 }

			set_variable = { name = rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm value = 0 }

			set_variable = { name = rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm value = 1 }

			set_variable = { name = rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm value = 2 }

			set_variable = { name = rpm_pm0_building_white_house value = 2 }
		}
	}
}

# Scope: state. Put production methods back to the snapshot.

# building resets its production methods.

				activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_tractors }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm = 4 }
				activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_compression_ignition_tractors }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_white_house }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_white_house }
			if = {
				limit = { var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 0 }
				activate_production_method = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_default_building_white_house }
			}

			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 2 }
				activate_production_method = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_no_effects }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Count what the rebel AI changed, into country variables.

	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_angkor_wat }

			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rpm_lvl_building_angkor_wat } }

		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { b:building_angkor_wat.level > var:rpm_lvl_building_angkor_wat }

					change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_levels_added add = scope:rpm_delta }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { b:building_angkor_wat.level < var:rpm_lvl_building_angkor_wat }

			scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_buildings_new add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { b:building_port.level > var:rpm_lvl_building_port }
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = rpm_delta
					value = {
						value = b:building_port.level
						subtract = var:rpm_lvl_building_port
					}
				}
				scope:rpm_player = {
					change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_buildings_expanded add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_levels_added add = scope:rpm_delta }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { b:building_port.level < var:rpm_lvl_building_port }

					var:rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm = 1
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_herring_meal_farming } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm = 2
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_soil_enriching_farming } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm = 3
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_fertilization } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm = 4
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_chemical_fertilizer } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm = 0
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_no_secondary } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm = 1
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_citrus_orchards } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm = 2
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_sugar_beets } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm = 0
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_tools_disabled } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm = 1
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_tools } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm = 2
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_steam_threshers } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm = 3
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_tractors } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm = 4
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_compression_ignition_tractors } }
				}
				}
			}
			scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_pm_buildings add = 1 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_white_house }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rpm_lvl_building_white_house } }
			scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_buildings_new add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { b:building_white_house.level > var:rpm_lvl_building_white_house }
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = rpm_delta
					value = {
						value = b:building_white_house.level
						subtract = var:rpm_lvl_building_white_house
					}
				}
				scope:rpm_player = {
					change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_buildings_expanded add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_levels_added add = scope:rpm_delta }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { b:building_white_house.level < var:rpm_lvl_building_white_house }
				scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_buildings_reduced add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_white_house }
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 0
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_default_building_white_house } }
				}
				scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_pm_changes add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 1
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_prestige_only } }
				}
				scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_pm_changes add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 2
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_no_effects } }
				}
				scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_pm_changes add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_white_house
					var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 0
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_default_building_white_house } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_white_house
					var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 1
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_prestige_only } }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_white_house
					var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 2
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_no_effects } }
				}
				}
			}
			scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_pm_buildings add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}
